yamlDiff.changedPlaceholder: Paste or drop the changed YAML (or JSON)
yamlDiff.idle: Fill both panes and the comparison runs as you type.
yamlDiff.privacy: Both documents are parsed and compared in this browser — nothing is uploaded, which is the point for manifests carrying hostnames and secret names.
yamlDiff.resolveAnchors: 将锚点和别名解析为其实际值
yamlDiff.parseFailed: 一侧解析失败 — 未进行任何比较
yamlDiff.equivalent: No differences — the two documents resolve to the same structure
yamlDiff.equivalentStructural: Same resolved structure · {n} formatting or anchor differences
yamlDiff.documentCountMismatch: Document count differs: {original} vs {changed} — documents were paired in order and the extras reported whole

rule.keyOrder: 映射键的顺序、引号和缩进将被忽略；序列顺序会进行比较，因为列表的顺序具有含义。
rule.anchors: 别名会解析为其值，因此共享锚点背后的编辑会在每个别名位置显示；如果锚点或别名发生变化但值保持不变，则会单独报告为结构性变更。
rule.mergeKeys: Merge keys (<<) are expanded before comparing, and a node's own keys win over merged ones.
rule.types: Type is part of the value: 8080, "8080" and !!str 8080 are reported as type changes, not as a generic change.
rule.sequences: Sequences of mappings pair by name, id or key when that field is unique on both sides, so one inserted item does not cascade; a reorder is still reported.
rule.blockScalars: 块标量按解析后的字符串进行比较，因此 |- 去除的尾随换行符是实际变更；相同值的重新格式化属于结构变化。
rule.comments: Comments are not part of the YAML data model and are not compared.
rule.multiDoc: --- streams pair document by document; a count mismatch is reported instead of comparing only the first.
rule.duplicateKeys: A duplicate mapping key in the input uses the last occurrence and is reported as a warning.

note.raw-text-mode: 纯文本模式按字符比较，而非结构：键顺序、引号和缩进均会影响结果。
note.parse-error: 一侧无法解析，因此未进行比较。
note.document-count-mismatch: The two sides hold a different number of --- documents; documents were paired in order and the extras reported whole.
note.merge-keys-expanded: Merge keys (<<) were expanded before comparing.
note.anchors-unresolved: Aliases were compared as *name references, not as their resolved values.
note.yaml11-ambiguous-scalars: Unquoted y/n/yes/no/on/off read as strings here (YAML 1.2 Core) and as booleans under YAML 1.1 — quote them if a boolean was meant.
note.sequence-matched-by-identity: 映射序列已通过标识字段而非位置进行配对。
note.duplicate-keys: 映射中声明了重复的键；将使用最后一个出现的值。
